import importlib.metadata, json, os, subprocess, sys, time
from pathlib import Path
from tools.run_ci_tests import source_snapshot, summarize

root = Path.cwd()
out = root / "build/evidence/analysis-sources-234cae4aee53/qualification-7b2c999"
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
before = source_snapshot(root)
command = [
    sys.executable, "-m", "pytest", "tests/ui/test_analysis_sources.py",
    "-q", "-ra", "-p", "no:cacheprovider",
    "--basetemp=/dev/shm/capturesuite-234cae4aee53/source-candidate-7b2c999",
    f"--junitxml={out / 'pytest.xml'}", "-o", "faulthandler_timeout=45",
]
started = time.monotonic()
with (out / "pytest.log").open("w", encoding="utf-8") as log:
    try:
        process = subprocess.run(command, cwd=root, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                 timeout=180, check=False)
        code = process.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        code = None
after = source_snapshot(root)
report = summarize(out / "pytest.xml", code)
report.update(
    scope="Focused source selection UI and MCAP receiving; Windows MainWindow is a separate gate",
    command=command,
    source_commit=before["commit"],
    source_worktree_dirty=before["worktree_dirty"],
    source_tree_sha256=before["tree_sha256"],
    source_file_count=len(before["files"]),
    source_unchanged_during_test=before == after,
    seconds=time.monotonic() - started,
    runtime={name: importlib.metadata.version(name)
             for name in ("pytest", "PySide6", "numpy", "pandas", "mcap", "pyarrow")},
)
if before != after:
    report["accepted"] = False
    report["problems"].append("Source changed during receiving")
(out / "source-manifest.json").write_text(json.dumps(before, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
(out / "receipt.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
print((out / "pytest.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"), flush=True)
print("RECEIPT=" + json.dumps(report, sort_keys=True), flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if report["accepted"] else 1)
